name: Rick Rubin
hook: A punk kid who brought a rock producer's taste for loud and simple into rap, starting Def Jam from a university dorm on the way.
blurb: Rick Rubin grew up on Long Island and played in a hardcore punk band called Hose. Def Jam's first release was a 1982 single by Hose. At New York University he started producing rap records, and in 1984 he and Russell Simmons turned that name into a proper record label, which got distribution through Columbia the next year. His rap production kept only what hit hardest: a loud drum machine, the rapper, a DJ's scratches, and sometimes a rock guitar. LL Cool J's first album credits him with 'reducing' it rather than producing it. He is filed under rock on this map on purpose. He came to rap from the New York hardcore scene, and what he brought with him, the volume, the stripped-down arrangements and the belief that rap and rock guitar belonged together, is the heart of his effect on rap, which is why his connections into hip-hop cross between lineages. He left Def Jam in 1988 to start Def American, later American Recordings, and became one of the most famous producers in rock.
